column1: # note: Calls are the sites a unit calls: the seven coverage strata combined by the pooled site weights, read on the tool's wild-type candidate-site count per unit; the ratio is their quotient. Raw counts would mislead: the unmodified libraries hold 1.8-fold the share of sites above coverage 100, putting the raw control above the wild type for four tools; standardisation removes it. WT = wild type, unmodified IVT = negative control. CHEUI_m5C uses the corrected call set. Intervals are counting (Poisson) intervals: they carry counting error inside these libraries, not the spread between them, which the (SD) reports. NanoNm's arm is our HeLa_WT2 and HeLa_WT3 units plus the model's published per-site Nm set, which has no control; alone, our units give 0.962 (0.931-0.994), the published set 0.529.
